From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Emily Saunders <emily@octavehealth.com>
Cc: Trevor Mills <trevor.m@octavehealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pipeline hygiene: Octave Health RYG snapshot + save-plan

Team / Emily —

Quick hygiene note ahead of tomorrow's commit review: I ran a snapshot of our Q3 pipeline and flagged Octave Health as a yellow → needs a save-plan. Attached is the red/yellow/green export (q3_redyellowgreen_snapshot.xlsx) and a one-page mutual action plan template.

Key items:
- Current stage: Contract Review (verifying procurement terms).
- Risk reasons: procurement window slipped (now end of July), pricing ask on extended payment terms, open question on security evidence (SOC 2 scope).
- Revenue at risk: $240k (50% of expected close).

Asks by EOD today:
1) Marissa — confirm whether Octave should be marked "commit: no" vs "soft commit" for tomorrow's forecast. If you think a save-plan will restore probability, add a short bullet under the "action" column in the sheet.
2) Ben — please prep a 1-paragraph fallback offer (pricing+term concession) we can present if procurement presses.
3) Karthik — check whether we can accelerate SOC 2 artifact delivery (ETA and owner).
4) Emily / Octave — any updates on procurement timeline and preferred payment cadence? If you can share the PO or procurement contact, loop them in.

I'll aggregate inputs and push an updated HubSpot note: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/OD-5821

Thanks — aim is to keep this out of red by next checkpoint.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher | Senior AM, Enterprise 
Redwood Inference

Attachment: q3_redyellowgreen_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 tab)
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v3.pdf (1 page PDF)
